summary: T is the twist of R by the avatar of μ⁻¹, a labelled column with the twisted labels, hence a row; the trace identity is proved at Frobenius elements, where both sides are read off the Hecke polynomials of the lift, and extended by continuity (limits along Frobenii).

steps.claim: |n| is even and |r| − O.rankDiff is even (|r| and O.rankDiff are odd by IsApt): write N' for the evenness of |n| and |r| − rankDiff = 2a with a ∈ ℤ, the difference taken in ℤ (it may be negative).

steps.claim: The trace of the normalised representation at σ is minus the coefficient of X^{|n|−1} of its characteristic polynomial (|n| > 0), and ϑ.invAvatar is unfolded.

By uniqueness of limits it suffices that both sides are limits of the same values along the Frobenius data x approaching σ: the characteristic-polynomial coefficients of S are the limits of ιℓ of the coefficients of the Hecke polynomials H(x.w) (Attached.tendsto_charpoly_coeff), and tr T(σ) is the limit of the values ιℓ(b(x.w)(1)) times the avatar (hypothesis s).
The remaining factors (characters evaluated at the Frobenius) are continuous, so they tend to their values at σ (tendsto_mostFrobeniiAt).

It suffices to compare the two sides at most Frobenius data x: those whose place x.w has a Hecke polynomial for y (eigenform), is not a place of V nor conjugate to one and not above ℓ (eventually_mostFrobenii, eventually_notMem_star_notMem), and at which the avatars of ϑ⁻¹ and μ⁻¹ are the values of the Hecke characters at the Frobenius (eventually_avatar_frob, d, d').
steps.lean:
filter_upwards [eventually_mostFrobenii (f.2.and (eventually_notMem_star_notMem ℓ
    (.image V.placeAt ⊤))), (ϑ.hasWeight.inv.toAlgebraic 0 0).eventually_avatar_frob,
    (O.hasWeight.inv.toAlgebraic 0 a).eventually_avatar_frob] with x ⟨u, o, _, hl⟩ d d'

steps.claim: At x.w (of prime norm) y is spherical with the Hecke polynomial of the lift: E(T) = ∏_{l<rankDiff}(1 − q^l ν T)·H_{b(w)}(q^{rankDiff} ν/ν' T) (V.Lifts y b; ν, ν' the Frobenius values of V's characters a, b).
steps.lean: choose _ z s E v using u x.prime_q

steps.claim: For every T: H(x.w)(T) = E(T), since y ≠ 0 and both polynomials give the eigenvalue of the Hecke polynomial operator at T on y (isSphericalWith_of_heckeSplit).

steps.claim: H(x.w) is monic of degree |n|; compare the values at T = 0 (i) and the derivatives at T = 0 (l) of the two sides of step 2.2.6.
steps.lean: obtain ⟨m, i, l⟩ := (u x.prime_q).2.isMonicOfDegree f.1, k 0, congr(-deriv ($(k ·)) 0)

steps.claim: E(0) = 1, and −E'(0) = Σ_{l<rankDiff} q^l ν + q^{rankDiff}(ν/ν')·q^{…}b(x.w)(1) (product and sum rules for the derivative), which gives the coefficient of the characteristic polynomial at X^{|n|−1}.
